solution.text:
We know that family of planes equation is given by, P1+λP2=0

⇒x+3y-z-5+λ2x-y+z-3=0

2,1,-2 lies on this plane

∴λ=1⇒ So the equation of required plane is 3x+2y-8=0

Now let P=3x+2y-8=0

So, P1=3×1+2×-2-8=-9

P2=3×5+2-1-8=5

Since P1×P2<0, So X and Y are on the opposite sides of plane P
